legend: Luisa is playing in a Mario Kart championship, and one of her competitors released a flurry of green shells on her. Green shells are a power up that, when used, will launch a turtle shell in some direction indefinitely and will bounce off walls until it hits some other competitor. Luisa is unsure of the exact mechanics that define the path of a green shell; all she knows is that she wants to avoid them, and the more paths to the finish line there are, the less likely she is to encounter one.

Being a good friend of hers, you have hacked into the map and can now redesign it to her benefit. You know there are $$$n$$$ junctions in the current map Luisa is racing in, and you will redesign the map by first removing all pre-existing roads, then by adding in roads connecting a pair of junctions. These roads can be traversed bidirectionally. You also know that Luisa will always take the least number of roads needed to reach the junction containing the finish line, regardless of the lengths of the roads. To minimize the chances that Luisa encounters a green shell, you want to redesign the map to maximize the number of routes Luisa can take. Before considering the new map design, you first want to answer the following question: what is the maximum number of shortest routes you can achieve with any new map design?

More formally, let the map Luisa is on be represented by a graph. If she is currently in node $$$1$$$ and her target is in node $$$n$$$, determine the maximum number of shortest paths that you can create by placing edges between pairs of nodes. A shortest path from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ is defined as a path with the minimal number of edges that starts in node $$$1$$$ and ends in node $$$n$$$.
input: The first and only line of input will consist of a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \leq n \leq 10^9$$$) — the number of junctions in the map.
output: Output a single integer: the maximum number of shortest paths you can create. Since this value can be large, output the answer under modulo 998244353.

legend.ai: 路易莎正在参加一场马里奥赛车锦标赛，她的一名对手向她发射了一连串绿色龟壳。绿色龟壳是一种强化道具，使用后会朝某个方向无限飞行，并在墙壁间反弹，直到击中其他竞争者。路易莎不清楚绿色龟壳的具体运动路径机制；她只知道自己想躲开它们，而且通往终点线的路径越多，她遇上绿色龟壳的可能性就越小。

作为她的好朋友，你黑进了地图，现在可以为了她的利益重新设计地图。你知道 Luisa 当前比赛的地图中有 $$$n$$$ 个路口。你将先移除所有已有道路，然后添加连接任意一对路口的道路。这些道路均可双向通行。

你还知道，无论道路长度如何，Luisa 总会选择经过道路数量最少的路线到达包含终点线的路口。为了尽量降低 Luisa 遇到绿色龟壳的概率，你希望重新设计地图，使 Luisa 可以选择的路线数量尽可能多。

在考虑新地图设计之前，你想先回答以下问题：在任意新地图设计下，能够实现的最短路线数量最大是多少？
更正式地，将 Luisa 所在的地图表示为一张图。若她当前位于节点 $$$1$$$，目标位于节点 $$$n$$$，请确定通过在节点对之间添加边，最多可以构造出多少条最短路。从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 的最短路定义为：一条从节点 $$$1$$$ 出发并在节点 $$$n$$$ 结束，且边数最少的路径。

input.ai: 输入的第一行也是唯一一行，包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$2 \leq n \leq 10^9$$$)——地图中的交叉口数量。

output.ai: 输出一个整数：你能构造出的最短路径的最大数量。由于该值可能很大，请输出答案对 998244353 取模的结果。
